meta.title: MERIT codebase inspection: project references and runtime paths

views.label: Project references only
views.note: Seven ProjectReference edges from the .csproj files; Domain and Contracts reference no other project.

views.label: Synchronous web traffic
views.note: One HTTP request: controller, Application service, Data repository, stored procedure, response, all inside the request.

views.label: Asynchronous background work
views.note: Web enqueues a job row; JobWorker polls, claims it with READPAST, rebuilds the user's session scope and runs JobDispatcher.

cards.title: Merit.Web (src/Merit.Web/Program.cs)
items: Cookie auth with TOTP MFA, a permission policy per action, antiforgery, CSP nonce, rate limiting
Hosts the Angular build under /app/ and the JSON API under /api/v1
Synchronous: every database call happens inside the HTTP request that caused it

cards.title: Merit.Worker (src/Merit.Worker/JobWorker.cs)
items: JobWorker: poll, uspClaimNextJob (UPDLOCK, READPAST), rebuild the requesting user's session scope, JobDispatcher.RunAsync
ClusterScheduler runs clusterDetection on an interval; QueueHealthCheck reports /health/queues
Asynchronous: work is decoupled from the request that queued it

cards.title: Merit.Application
items: Ports: IAccountData, IConfigData, IPersonData, IPlaceData, IResultData, ICaseData, IWorkData, IIntakeData, IExtractData, IReviewData, ICurrentSession
Services: Account, Admin, Audit, Case, Classification, Cluster, Config, Extract, Intake, Investigation, Lookup, MatchReview, Person, Place, Profile, Queue, Report, Result, Search
IntakeProcessor, ExtractBuilder, JobDispatcher; packages: Microsoft.Extensions abstractions only

cards.title: Merit.Domain
items: Namespaces: Classification, Extracts, Identifiers, Ids, Matching, Population, Residence, Results, Text, Thresholds
CaseClassifier, MatchComparer, PrimaryResidencePlanner, ResultNormalizer, ThresholdEvaluator, TimeOrderedId

cards.title: Merit.Data.SqlServer and the database
items: Db opens a connection, sets read-only SESSION_CONTEXT (scopeKey, appUserId, actingTenantId) and runs stored procedures
Repositories: AccountAndConfigData, PersonAndPlaceData, ResultAndCaseData, WorkIntakeExtractData, ReviewData
Web enqueues jobs (for example uspCreateIntakeBatch) and Worker claims them, so the queue table is the only hand-off between the two processes

cards.title: Merit.Contracts
items: ApiContracts.cs: request and response records for /api/v1 (PagedResult, WorkTaskDto, MatchReviewDto, ReportDto ...)
No references; used only by Merit.Web, mirrored by the Angular contracts.ts
